states.noVisibleFactsBody: Health cannot assess risk until usable Money, Plan, or Inbox facts are visible.

narratives.starting: Set up Money and Plan to strengthen the household pulse.
narratives.steady: Solid footing — clear Inbox items to keep momentum.
narratives.strong: Strong pulse — keep partners aligned on decisions.

emiCelebrateBody: Celebrate in Inbox — clearing remaining principal marks completion. Health never invents a new balance.

insights.title: Insights
insights.subtitle: Read-only notices from household facts only
insights.loadErrorBody: Check your connection and try again.
insights.emptyDescription: As Money, Plan, and Inbox grow, light insights appear here.
insights.scenarioReadOnly: These scenarios are read-only and do not change money, plans, or decisions.

emi_complete.title: Installment complete
emi_complete.body: An EMI completion is waiting in Inbox. Celebrate with your partner — no new ledger balance is invented here.

setup.title: Finish household setup
setup.body: Accounts: {accountCount}. Active jars: {jarCount}. Real position lives in Money; jars stay intention.

inbox.title: Inbox needs attention
inbox.body: {count, plural, one {# open item is waiting for a decision.} other {# open items are waiting for a decision.}}

activity.title: Recent ledger activity
activity.body: {count, plural, =0 {No recent cleared moves yet — capture when ready.} one {# recent ledger move (real position only).} other {# recent ledger moves (real position only).}}

plan.title: Plan intention is active
plan.body: {count, plural, one {# Active jar is guiding intention — not bank balance.} other {# Active jars are guiding intention — not bank balance.}}

ai_guardrail.title: Assist stays honest
ai_guardrail.body: Phase 2 AI may explain from household data only. It must not invent balances or move money without an explicit path.

clear_inbox.title: If Inbox clears
clear_inbox.body: Clearing {count, plural, one {# open item} other {# open items}} lifts the pulse without changing ledger totals.

add_jar.title: If you add an Active jar
add_jar.body: An Active jar strengthens intention. It never becomes unlabeled bank balance.

keep_rhythm.title: If rhythm holds
keep_rhythm.body: Partners deciding together keeps Health visible — score from setup and Inbox load, not invented cash.
